text:
laura: FYI customer flagged two asks: BYOK for audit logs + 7-year retention with e-discovery export. sales wants a concrete pilot acceptance checklist. quick thoughts?

sam: 7 years is outside our usual retention. we should split retention (hot searchable vs cold export). legal will probably want controls around PII in logs. @sara-legal?

sara-legal: yep. key questions: what fields are "audit logs" vs telemetry? who can request e-discovery? need legal hold workflow. we should offer a contractual retention SLA + a self-serve export for customers.

ying: technical: propose Tiered retention model: Tier A (90d hot search, encrypted-at-rest with platform keys), Tier B (archive blobs encrypted with tenant KEK — BYOK — stored immutable in cold storage, exportable on demand). Phase 1 = BYOK + Tier B export only (no search).

jordan: agree phased. Phase 1 should avoid expanding SOC2 boundary; treat archival as opt-in tenant feature with documented controls. Also require signed customer acceptance for BYOK restrictions (we can't rebuild keys).

matt: infra impact: archive blobs change lifecycle (different shard compaction, immutability flags). we need cost estimates. also export format decision: ndjson vs parquet? parquet better for analytics but heavier. recommend ndjson + gz.

tom-sales: customers prefer searchable for investigations. can we commit to searchability in Phase 2 and pilot Phase 1 as export-only? sales can sell Phase 2 as roadmap item if we get pilot wins.

laura: acceptance checklist draft: 1) BYOK handshake implementation + documented key rotation behavior 2) Archive write + verify E2E (tenant-level immutable writes) 3) Export job completes and yields NDJSON gz for a 7y archive subset 4) Legal hold & deletion gating flows documented 5) Runbook + alerting for export failures 6) Pilot with 2 customers for 4 weeks

sam: add a performance gate: export generation for up to 1TB of archived data must complete within 24h for pilot. (we can set tighter later)

ying: add cryptographic gate: after rotation, ability to decrypt historical archive validated with test vectors. acceptance: rotation test and recovery scenario passed.

matt: ops gates: create export-failure alert -> PD high if job fails >1% over 15m. create storage-cost alert for tenant monthly archive > $X. add a dashboard tile for "archive export ETA".

ops-bot: alert policy "archive-export-failure" created; PagerDuty -> high. dashboard "Archive Retention - Pilot" created from template.

sara-legal: add data mapping requirement: the team must publish a mapping doc showing which log fields are retained and how PII is masked or redacted. legal hold acceptance = documented ability to pause deletions and produce an export within contract SLA.

laura: rollout gates + rollback: if export SLA missed for >48h across pilot tenants or unhandled KMS errors >10% in 1h, disable new pilot enrollments and open incident. rollback plan: flip tenant toggle and run emergency export.

tom-sales: timeline ask: can we start pilot onboarding in 5 weeks and GA in Q3 if Phase 2 (search) is scheduled next quarter? need clear commitments for customers.

matt: 5 weeks tight but doable for Phase 1 if we scope: BYOK + archive write + export only. need an infra spike this sprint to validate cold storage layout and costs.

ying: i'll land design doc for BYOK handshake + rotation by EOW and include recovery test vectors.

laura: owners: Product (laura) acceptance + pilot, Infra (matt) archive storage + export SLOs, Security (ying) BYOK + rotation tests, Legal (sara-legal) data mapping + hold process, Sales (tom-sales) pilot customers. Ops will own alerting and runbook.

sam: please include a customer-facing note about responsibilities: e.g., BYOK customers are responsible for key escrow decisions; we cannot restore archives if customer loses key unless using escrow.

laura: agreed. action items I 1) matt create infra spike ticket; 2) ying publish design PR; 3) sara-legal draft signoff/hold checklist; 4) laura produce pilot acceptance tests and customer-facing responsibilities doc; 5) tom-sales confirm pilot customers.

jordan: also recommend adding telemetry gates: monitor archive write success rate, KMS latencies, export durations, and cost per GB. define thresholds in the acceptance tests.

ops-bot: reminder posted in #eng-oncall: BYOK/archive runbook template available at https://confluence.redwood-inference/internal/archive-byok-runbook

laura: scheduling 30m sync Friday to review spike outcomes and pilot candidate list. thanks all.

matt: 44d

ying: 44d

sara-legal: will share mapping template by EOD tomorrow.

tom-sales: I'll shortlist two pilot customers and sync with laura next week.
